images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a quiet art game about a village telephone operator, cinematic letterbox bars top and bottom. Dark rural exchange room at night, 1961. Left and center: a large wooden-framed window with a cross mullion showing a snowless winter village under deep navy blue sky, stars and a hazy moon; small peaked-roof houses along a river with warm amber windows, a post office with a red sign, a church steeple, a bridge with four glowing lamps, faint chimney smoke. Right: a small worn wooden switchboard with twelve brass jacks, all dark except one lamp pulsing blood red above a label reading unregistered line 13. A yellowed handwritten warning note and a headset rest on the desk. Ink-blue and single-amber palette, heavy film grain, deep vignette, serif subtitles centered at the bottom. Korean UI text: "13번 · 미등록 회선", "침묵 00:41", "꽂는다".

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the same village-operator art game after the forbidden call was connected, same room and same window, cinematic letterbox bars. The view through the window is now cold and desaturated gray-blue: snow falling, snow on the roofs, almost every window dark, only one bridge lamp still lit, the moon pale and dim, and where a house stood beside the post office there is only an empty snowy lot with a faint dotted ghost outline of the missing house. On the right, a short cream serif list fades in naming what disappeared from the village; below it the small switchboard with lamp 13 now burning steady cold white and a dark red patch cord hanging down to the headset on the desk. Muted monochrome palette, soft haze, film grain, heavy vignette, italic subtitle of silence at the bottom. Korean UI text: "연결 후, 마을에서 사라진 것", "침묵 03:12", "우체국 옆집".
